operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates an existing branch. This posts to the same `/v2/api/entity/branch` path as create; the record to update is identified by the **`id` in the request body**. If `id` is omitted a new branch is created instead.

This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. **Requires the Branches plugin to be enabled on the account.**

**This is a partial merge, not a full overwrite.** Only the fields you include in the body are changed; any field you omit is left untouched. The updatable fields are `name`, `code`, and `status`. Only these fields can be updated — `id`, `name`, `status`, `created`, `modified`, and `code`. Other branch attributes (phone numbers, address, city, state, country, assigned staff, SMTP account, map location) are **not** available through this endpoint.

On success the response is `{ "message": <localized text>, "id": <id> }`. The success message is the same text returned by create, so it does not distinguish an update from an insert.

The `status` value is one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `1` | Active |
| `2` | Inactive |
| `3` | Suspended |

id.description: Id of the branch to update. Required — omitting it creates a new branch instead.

name.description: Branch name. Optional; only the fields you send are changed.

code.description: Branch code. Optional; only the fields you send are changed.

status.description:
Branch status. Optional; only the fields you send are changed.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Active |
| 2 | Inactive |
| 3 | Suspended |

message.description: Localized success message (identical to the create message).

400.description: The update could not be saved (for example a database constraint was violated).

e.description: Error detail. For a database-constraint failure: `{errorInfo, connectionName, readWriteType}`.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks the permission to manage branches.
